objective: Publish the integrity manifest last from successful training runs and validate present same-directory manifests before single-image artifact deserialization while preserving legacy bundles and public APIs.
acceptance_criteria: A successful run_imagefolder_training_workflow publishes the integrity manifest only after the three canonical portable artifacts have been written successfully, and the manifest verifies the final bytes actually present at the canonical paths.

If any canonical artifact write or manifest calculation/publication fails, the exception remains visible, no partial manifest is exposed, and a stale manifest from an older bundle cannot falsely attest the newly mixed artifact set.
The existing per-file atomicity contract remains explicit: this checkpoint does not claim or simulate a multi-file transaction and does not roll back already published canonical artifacts.

Single-image inference automatically verifies a present fixed-name manifest before loading model JSON, class mapping, or state dict when the three requested canonical paths identify one common bundle directory.

A present manifest with a missing, size-mismatched, digest-mismatched, renamed, or malformed artifact fails before model construction or image inference with a bounded actionable error that identifies the affected canonical artifact without exposing file contents.

A legacy bundle without a manifest continues through the established semantic validation and inference path unchanged, and explicit noncanonical artifact paths retain their existing behavior rather than silently binding to an unrelated sibling manifest.

Training and inference public dataclasses, controller/worker contracts, three canonical artifact schemas, checkpoint/TorchScript behavior, stop semantics, and result values remain backward compatible.

Deterministic CPU tests cover successful publication and inference, stale-manifest invalidation, artifact-write and manifest-write failures, corrupted JSON/state-dict/mapping bytes, manifest absence compatibility, and validation-before-deserialization without network, CUDA, arbitrary sleeps, assertion deletion, or assertion weakening.
Only the six allowed implementation/test files are changed and no GUI, documentation, dependency, launcher, packaging, or Git work is introduced.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 15 CP2 only in the six allowed files. Reuse the CP1 artifact_manifest API. Have the existing ImageFolder workflow invalidate any stale integrity manifest before it starts replacing canonical bundle members, then publish a new manifest last and atomically only after model_definition.json, best_model_state_dict.pt, and class_mapping.json are all successfully published. Preserve Phase 8 per-file atomicity and do not claim a multi-file transaction or add rollback. In single-image inference, before deserialization, verify a present fixed-name manifest only when the three requested paths are the exact canonical filenames in one common directory. Fail closed on a present invalid manifest with bounded actionable errors; preserve legacy no-manifest and explicit noncanonical-path behavior. Do not change public request/result/controller/worker APIs or existing artifact/checkpoint/TorchScript formats. Add deterministic CPU tests that prove ordering, stale-manifest safety, failures, tamper detection before deserialization, and backward compatibility. Do not modify GUI/docs/dependencies/markers, weaken or delete assertions, use network/CUDA/arbitrary sleep, touch any other file, or perform Git operations.
estimated_scope: Medium training and inference integration with focused regressions, approximately 300-550 changed lines across six existing/new files.
